title: trigonotis peduncularis var. amblyosepala
intro: Trigonotis peduncularis var. amblyosepala, commonly known as the "Chinese Trigonotis," is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the family Boraginaceae. It is a medicinal plant traditionally used in Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The therapeutic actions of Trigonotis peduncularis var. amblyosepala include anti-inflammatory, expectorant, and antipyretic properties, which help to relieve symptoms associated with respiratory and gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
